title: 第2672章 活着就好第2671章 本王还是喜欢摘现成的果子
lines: “宁宸，老夫不会放过你，你毁老夫的长生路，老夫与你不死不休······”
柳枫恶毒的嘶吼，在那朵金色莲花彻底被从尸体眉心拔出来后，彻底消失了。
宁宸看着手里的金色莲花，只觉得口齿生津。
他将其放在嘴边，张嘴一吸，那金莲便化作无数道金色气流没入他的口中。
金色气流入口，宁宸便感觉到脑袋如针扎般疼痛，让他忍不住闷哼一声。
痛感来得快，去得也快。
痛感消失，取而代之的是一种难以言喻的舒服感，这种感觉难以形容，就像是置身云端，浑身轻飘飘的，耳聪目明，他好像能听到极为细微的声音，能看得更远更清楚。
宁宸沉浸在这种感觉中，丝毫没发现周围人的异样和惊悚。
潘玉成，卫鹰几人来找宁宸，雨蝶却朝着他们做出一个噤声的手势。
然后他们便看到宁宸行为举动十分怪异。
他先是自言自语，什么长生，什么你必须死···然后盯着地上残缺变形的尸体吞咽口水，一副馋样，最后伸手在空中抓了什么，然后张嘴猛吸，接着露出一脸享受的样子。
宁宸现在的行为看上去，诡异至极，就像是中邪了一样。
潘玉成几人面面相觑。
最后，潘玉成实在担心宁宸的精神状况，“王爷，您···没事吧？”
“嘘······”雨蝶急忙做了个噤声的手势，示意潘玉成不要打扰宁宸，压低声音说道：“王爷之前说过，不管他做出什么奇怪的举动，都不要惊讶。”
可潘玉成看着宁宸诡异的举动，实在是放心不下。
他压低声音，道：“卫鹰，你去把宋知玄他们找来，想来这些江湖术士，应该懂得驱邪避恶之法。”
卫鹰点头，王爷看上去的确不太正常，可就在他准备去找宋知玄等人的时候，却见宁宸缓缓站起身来。
“王爷！”
雨蝶轻轻喊了一声。
宁宸扭头看来，见她脸上带着掩饰不住的担心，还有潘玉成等人不知道什么时候来的？
刚才他沉浸在一种奇异的感觉中，对周围的一切置若罔闻。
“放心，我没事！”
宁宸笑着说道。
他还能笑得出来，是不知道自己刚才的举动有多诡异，如果知道···能把自己吓一跳。
突然，宁宸脸上的笑容敛去，语气急促，“可有老冯的消息？”
卫鹰俯身，道：“王爷放心，冯将军找到了，人活着，但是摔断了腿，军医正在帮冯将军医治。”
宁宸大喜，“活着就好，活着就好······本王就知道老冯傻人有傻福，不可能这么轻易死掉。”
潘玉成看向雨蝶，“那两只金雕也受了伤，但它们性情凶猛，军医无法靠近······”
本来他前面就想说的，但还没张嘴，雨蝶就对他做了个噤声的手势，然后就看到宁宸诡异的举动，导致他把要说的事忘得一干二净！
雨蝶一惊，“快带我去！”
卫鹰赶紧前面带路。
不多时，他们来到山崖下唯一一块还算平坦的地方。
远远的，便听到冯奇正大着嗓门喊道：“你们离它远点，别靠太近，它们很害怕······”
同时，还有金雕尖锐且痛苦的唳鸣声。
“快让开，王爷来了！”
content_en:
;;
"Ning Chen, I will not let you go. If you ruin my path to immortality, I will fight you until death..."
Liu Feng's vicious roar disappeared completely after the golden lotus was completely pulled out from the forehead of the corpse.
Ning Chen looked at the golden lotus in his hand and felt salivating.
He put it to his mouth, opened his mouth and sucked it in, and the golden lotus turned into countless golden airflows and sank into his mouth.
As soon as the golden air entered the entrance, Ning Chen felt the pain in his head like needles, which made him groan.
The pain comes and goes quickly.
The pain disappeared and was replaced by an indescribable feeling of comfort. This feeling was indescribable. It was like being in the clouds, his body was light and his eyes were sharp. He seemed to be able to hear extremely small sounds and see farther and clearer.
Ning Chen was immersed in this feeling and did not notice the strangeness or horror of the people around him at all.
Pan Yucheng, Wei Ying and others came to find Ning Chen, but Yudie made a silent gesture toward them.
Then they saw Ning Chen acting very strangely.
He first muttered to himself, about immortality, about you must die... Then he stared at the mutilated and deformed corpse on the ground and swallowed, looking greedy. Finally, he reached out and grabbed something in the air, then opened his mouth and sucked it hard, and then showed a look of enjoyment on his face.
Ning Chen's current behavior looks extremely strange, as if he is possessed by a demon.
Pan Yucheng and others looked at each other.
Finally, Pan Yucheng was really worried about Ning Chen's mental condition, "My lord, are you... okay?"
"Shh..." Yudie hurriedly made a silent gesture to signal Pan Yucheng not to disturb Ning Chen, and lowered his voice and said: "The prince said before, no matter what strange behavior he makes, don't be surprised."
But Pan Yucheng was really worried when he saw Ning Chen's strange behavior.
He lowered his voice and said: "Wei Ying, go and find Song Zhixuan and the others. I think these charlatans should know how to ward off evil and avoid evil."
Wei Ying nodded. The prince did not look normal, but just when he was about to go find Song Zhixuan and others, he saw Ning Chen slowly stand up.
"Your Majesty!"
Yudie shouted softly.
Ning Chen turned around and saw the worry that could not be concealed on her face. Pan Yucheng and others also came. I don't know when they came?
Just now, he was immersed in a strange feeling and turned a deaf ear to everything around him.
"Don't worry, I'm fine!"
Ning Chen said with a smile.
He could still laugh, but he didn't know how weird his behavior just now was. If he knew...it would scare him.
Suddenly, the smile on Ning Chen's face faded, and his tone was urgent, "Is there any news about Lao Feng?"
Wei Ying leaned over and said: "Don't worry, Your Majesty, General Feng has been found. He is alive, but his leg was broken. Military doctors are treating General Feng."
Ning Chen was overjoyed, "It's good to be alive, it's good to be alive... I know that old Feng, a stupid man, has a stupid blessing, and he can't die so easily."
Pan Yucheng looked at Yudie, "The two golden eagles were also injured, but they are ferocious and the military doctors cannot get close..."
He had originally wanted to say something before, but before he opened his mouth, Yudie made a silent gesture to him. Then he saw Ning Chen's strange behavior, which caused him to completely forget what he wanted to say!
Yudie was startled, "Take me there quickly!"
Wei Ying quickly led the way.
After a while, they came to the only flat place under the cliff.
From a distance, I heard Feng Qi shouting in a loud voice: "Stay away from it, don't get too close, they are very scared..."
At the same time, there is the sharp and painful chirping sound of the golden eagle.
"Get out of the way, the prince is coming!"
